evals.prompt: Review the staged request that explicitly asks to skip the development process and edit only the bounded current checkout. Complete the semantic owner result and invoke the public wrapper without another confirmation.
evals.expected_output: The public DTO selects the bounded current-checkout route.

evals.prompt: Review the staged request with implicit process-skipping intent and one affirmative answer to the single clarification. Complete the semantic owner result and invoke the public wrapper.
evals.expected_output: The public DTO selects the bounded current-checkout route after one confirmation.

evals.prompt: Review the staged request with implicit process-skipping intent whose single clarification was refused. Complete the semantic owner result and invoke the public wrapper without asking again.
evals.expected_output: The public DTO selects normal Intake after refusal.

evals.prompt: Review the staged ordinary issue-backed file-changing request with no process-skipping intent. Complete the semantic owner result and invoke the public wrapper conservatively.
evals.expected_output: The public DTO selects normal Intake.

evals.prompt: Review the staged bounded current-checkout request with an unrelated dirty file. Complete the semantic owner result, invoke the public wrapper, and preserve the unrelated file unchanged.
evals.expected_output: The public DTO selects the bounded route without changing unrelated work.

evals.prompt: Review the staged same-scope retry carrying the current continuation identity and an already selected bounded route. Reuse the selection, complete the owner result, and invoke the public wrapper without another question.
evals.expected_output: The public DTO reuses the existing bounded route.

evals.prompt: Review the staged invocation whose current semantic selection result is unavailable. Complete the owner result and invoke the public wrapper through its declared fail-closed stop.
evals.expected_output: The public DTO stops without inventing a selected mode.
